{{Quote|Can I help you?|Milton Putna, to K-2SO|<ref name="R1" />}}
'''Milton Putna''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="UVG" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> he<ref name="ROA5" /> was in control of the door of the [[Scarif vault|vault]] of the [[Citadel Tower]] on [[Scarif]]. Due to his experience as a former [[librarian]], Putna was familiar with the structure of the [[Data-tape|data]] storage system. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] team known as [[Rogue One]] infiltrated the Citadel in the wake of the [[Battle of Scarif]], Putna was beaten down by the rebel-reprogrammed [[security droid]] [[K-2SO]], whereupon [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and [[Jyn Erso]] carried the unconscious [[Imperial officer|officer]] to the main door of the vault and used his right hand to gain access.<ref name="UVG" />
